lines.text: What did you do after work yesterday?
lines.speaker: Ping

lines.text: I went to the market and bought some fruit.
lines.speaker: Uma

lines.text: What time did you get to the market?
lines.speaker: Ping

lines.text: Around seven. It was still open when I got there.
lines.speaker: Uma

lines.text: Did you go straight home after that?
lines.speaker: Ping

lines.text: No, I met my sister for dinner near the market.
lines.speaker: Uma

lines.text: Where did you eat? I'm looking for a place nearby.
lines.speaker: Ping

lines.text: We ate at a little café on Plum Street.
lines.speaker: Uma
